title: No Ticket, No Deck
description: Every protected page in SwiftCargo is guarded the same way — no session, no access, full stop. Prove every route behind ProtectedRoute actually enforces that when hit cold, with no prior login in the browser.
successCondition: Starting from a fresh browser context with no session, directly navigating to each of /, /book, /tracking, /billing, /fleet, /admin, and /reporting redirects to /login every time (client-side Navigate, URL ends at /login), never rendering the target page's content even momentarily in a way an automated check would catch as a false pass.
hints: Clear cookies/local storage (or use a fresh incognito-style context) before each navigation so no stale session leaks in.
All seven protected routes share the same ProtectedRoute wrapper — if one fails, check whether it's actually wrapped correctly in App.tsx.
